Move uav to another area.desc: This action enables the uav to move from its current area to a different area if two areas are connected. For example, the uav moves from area_1 to area_2 if area_1 and area_2 are connected.
Move uav to another area.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to move from [position1] to [position2] if [position1] and [position2] are [state1].

Move ugv to another area.desc: This action enables the ugv to move from one area to another if two areas are connected. For example, the ugv moves from area_1 to area_2 if area_1 and area_2 are connected.
Move ugv to another area.abstract_desc: This action enables the ugv to move from [position1] to [position2] if [position1] and [position2] are [state1].

Monitor an area for fire.desc: This action enables the uav to mark an area dangerous if the area has fire and the uav is at that area. For example, if the uav at area_2 and area_2 has fire, uav will mark area_2 as dangerous.
Monitor an area for fire.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to mark [position1] as [state1], if [position1] has [object1] and the uav is at [position1].

Extinguish fire in an area.desc: This action enables the ugv to extinguish a fire in a area only if the area is dangerous. For example, the ugv extinguishes the fire in area_1 if area_1 has been marked as dangerous.
Extinguish fire in an area.abstract_desc: This action enables the ugv to remove [object1] in [position1] if [position1] is [state1].
